correctness.rationale: If center is ignited first, all leaves spread in the next round with color a*s_i, giving exactly the canonical coloring. If a leaf ignites first, the center spreads in round 2 with a=s_i*b, while every other leaf still lacks a burned neighbor at that round start; the optional ignition can choose at most one second leaf with arbitrary color. In round 3 all remaining leaves are forced canonical. For n>=2 each desired flipped leaf is reachable by first igniting a different leaf. Hence center color and flipped index uniquely encode 2(n+1) colorings. Counting yellow leaves gives z^(p+1)(1+p/z+qz)+z^q(1+q/z+pz), and maximize exponents for Y. For positive signing a target disagreeing with its center on k leaves is distance max(k-1,0) from same-center code, or 1+max(n-k-1,0) from opposite-center code; maximizing minimum over k gives max(1,floor((n-1)/2)). Switching on trees transports signed processes and converts worst-signing plurality to n+1-covering_radius. n=1 has only two configurations. Independent simulator exhausted all 2^n signings for n=1..7, comparing literal reachable sets and counts. This finite check corroborates the complete first-ignition dichotomy.
residual_risks: Exact state ordering spreading before ignition is essential; no claim for arbitrary trees, different burning variants, or histories counted with multiplicity.

value.rationale: Signed stars are the first branching tree family beyond the signed paths analyzed in the motivating primary paper. The result classifies every final coloring for every signing, computes its full distinct-color weight enumerator and covering radius, and identifies a sharp worst-signing plurality—natural coding and dynamic invariants across all n, rather than a routine n=3 sample.
residual_risks: Does not extend to nonstars, multiple ignition variants, or a classification of process histories.

final_claim: Under synchronous spreading before optional ignition in the two-colour signed-burning process, the full reachable final-colour code for every signed star is exactly a center-dictated spoke pattern with at most one flipped leaf (n>=2), yielding size 2(n+1), exact yellow-weight enumerator, plurality, covering radius for the positive star and worst-signing plurality; n=1 is separately handled.
limitations: One-player two-color synchronous spreading-before-ignition process with immutable burned colors.
n=1 separately special; codebooks count final configurations not burning sequences.
